verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI drives real browsers (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), so it can render JavaScript-heavy pages. It documents executing JS and waiting for async content, and simulated scrolling captures dynamically loaded content, which together cover the core of SPA rendering. However, the evidence mostly shows markdown output and never explicitly documents returning the rendered HTML. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a fully rendered HTML output field, SPA-specific wait or readiness docs, independent hands-on corroboration of rendering JS-heavy sites.
